requirements.text: claimcheck blocks a change that deletes a whole test. compareTestFile in src/checks/test-weakening.ts reports assertion-removed whenever a test file's expect() count drops, so deleting an obsolete test or splitting a file reads as stripping an assertion, and the decision BLOCKs. Deleting a test is ambiguous, not the strip-an-assertion cheat. When the expect() count drops and the file also has fewer test cases (it/test calls, including variants such as it.skip, it.only, test.each and xit), report a new test-weakening kind, test-removed, which the decision only WARNs on, like expected-value-changed. A drop in expect() calls with the test count unchanged is still assertion-removed and still blocks. Fix it, with a test.
